strings.dnd_unavailable: ʻOku ʻikai maʻu ʻa e toho mo e tuku. Ngāueʻaki ʻa e foʻi ki ʻi lalo.
strings.strategy_full: ☢  KAKATO — meʻa kotoa ʻi he noa (malu)
strings.shred_button: F A K A ʻ A U H A
strings.ssd_warning:
Tokanga! ʻI he SSD, ʻoku ʻikai fakapapauʻi ʻe he founga tohi ʻi ʻolunga ʻa e fakaʻauhá koeʻuhí ko e TRIM.
Ko e polokalama ni ʻoku maʻa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ko e faile "{name}" ʻe tohi ʻi ʻolunga pea tamateʻi.

Fakatau?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).

strings.report_title: ✅  NAʻE TOHI E FAILE ʻI ʻOLUNGA PEĀ TAMATEʻI
strings.report_limits:
• ʻOku ʻikai ngāueʻi ʻa e NTFS hala ʻo e ʻīkuna kehe (ADS).
• ʻOku ʻikai fakamaʻa ʻa e tohinoa USN.
• ʻOku ʻikai maʻu ʻa e tauhi ʻata mo e fengāueʻaki ʻi he ʻao
  (OneDrive mo e hā fua).
strings.step_delete: Tamateʻi ʻo fakalaka ʻi he puha ʻuhu
strings.status_full: Kuo tohi kakato ʻa e ʻīkuna ʻi he noa. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe maʻu — ʻe sio pē ʻa e ngaahi meʻangāue ki he noa.
strings.status_fast: Kuo tohi ʻa e ʻulu, ikuʻanga mo e 4 MB laine ʻi ʻolunga. ʻOku ʻikai maʻu ʻa e toe, ka koeʻuhí ko e ʻatā ʻoku ʻikai lava ʻe he ngaahi meʻangāue kaihoa ʻo toe maʻu kakato. Maʻa e ngaahi tohi fakapulipuli, ngāueʻaki ʻa e sīpili KAKATO.
strings.status_empty: Naʻe moʻua e faile, naʻe ʻikai fiemaʻu ʻa e tohi ʻi ʻolunga. Kuo tamateʻi.
strings.error_permission: ʻOku ʻikai lava ke maʻu e faile. Mahalo pē ʻoku ʻā ia ʻi ha polokalama kehe. Tāpuni ia pea toe feinga.
strings.error_not_found: Naʻe ʻikai maʻu e faile. Mahalo pē kuo tamateʻi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ko ha fehokotaki fakataipe ni. ʻOku ʻikai lava ʻo fakaʻauha e ngaahi fehokotaki — ʻe nofo maʻu pē ʻa e faile taumuʻa.
strings.error_reparse: Ko ha faile fakafofonga ni (OneDrive pe meʻa tatau). ʻOku ʻi he ʻao ʻana ʻīkuna, ʻikai ʻi he tisi — ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ke fakaʻauha heni.
strings.error_not_file: ʻOku ʻikai ko ha faile ni (fōtunga pe meʻa kehe). Tuku ha faile.
strings.error_hardlinks: ʻOku maʻu ʻe he faile ni ha ngaahi fehokotaki faʻa malō kehe ({n} kotoa). ʻOku ʻikai ha taki ʻa e ngaahi fehokotaki faʻa malō — ʻoku tatau ʻa e ngaahi hingoa kotoa. Kapau te ke fakaʻauha ʻi he halanga lolotonga, ʻe tohi ʻa e ʻīkuna ʻi ʻolunga pea tuʻusi ki he 32 paiti, ka ʻe ʻi ai pē ʻa e toe ʻoku lava ke maʻu ʻi he ngaahi fehokotaki kehe. Tamateʻi ʻa e ngaahi fehokotaki kotoa ʻi he ʻuluaki.
strings.error_compressed:
ʻOku fakapipiki, fakapulipuli pe hokohoko e faile. ʻOku ʻikai fakapapauʻi ʻe he tohi ʻi he noa ʻa e fakaʻauhá ʻo e ʻīkuna motuʻa he ʻoku tauhi ʻe NTFS ia ʻi ha founga kehe.

Toʻo ʻa e ʻulungaanga: kiliki toʻomataʻu → Ngaahi ʻulungaanga → Fakalakalaka → toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻi he Fakapipiki mo/pe Fakapulipuli. Hili ia, toe fakahoko ʻa e SHREDDER.
